radix/corpus/intrinseca/textus-transformationes.fab (canonical · keyword)#

Primitive string/text type.

# =============================================================================
# पाठ — Primitive string/text type
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Primitive string/text type.
#   • Related keywords: string, लिखित, ↦
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • Using `पाठ` transform methods on non-text types — `.slice()`, `.uppercase()`, `.lowercase()`, `.trim()`, `.split()`, `.replace()` are textus-only compiler intrinsics.
#
# See also: string, लिखित, ↦
# =============================================================================

# पाठ slice and transform intrinsics
#
# Compiler-owned पाठ methodi — sectio, maiuscula, minuscula, recide,
# divide, muta.
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   s.slice(lo, hi) | s.uppercase() | s.lowercase() | s.trim()
#   s.split(sep) | s.replace(old, new)
#
# divide returns सूची<पाठ>; pairs with सूची/ exempla for collection smoke.
# Derived locals use बैठा to avoid repeating स्थिर _ across the transform chain.
# Wasm tier Runnable.
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   Smoke asserts exit 0 only.

main {
    let nuntius ← " Ave Roma "

    let secta ← nuntius.slice(1, 4)
    let magna ← nuntius.uppercase()
    let parva ← nuntius.lowercase()
    let rasa ← nuntius.trim()
    let partes ← rasa.split(" ")
    let mutata ← rasa.replace("Roma", "Munde")

    print secta, magna, parva
    print rasa, partes, mutata
}

Decline: a पाठ literal longer than the target capacity rejects with textus_literal_too_long.

# =============================================================================
# पाठ overflow decline — literal over capacity fails closed
# =============================================================================
#
# Decline row (reject reason in the comment):
#   1. over capacity — `"abcdef" ↦ string<4>` asks a 6-scalar literal to fit
#      a capacity of 4: SEM011 textus_literal_too_long
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • expecting silent truncation — the D7 overflow rule fails closed at
#     check for literals whose scalar count exceeds the target capacity
#
# See also: ↦, पाठ
# =============================================================================

# पाठ literal over capacity — expected compile failure
#
# WHY: pins the fail-closed overflow token in conversio-textus-overflow-decline.expected.

main {
    const string<4> t ← "abcdef" ↦ string<4>
    print t
}

Expected: compilation rejects this example.

Decline: bounded पाठ<N> cannot convert directly to ascii<M>.

# =============================================================================
# bounded पाठ to ascii — unsupported बदलें decline
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Unicode text and bounded ASCII have different बदलें contracts.
#   • The unsupported route fails closed with `SEM016:unsupported_conversio`.
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • assuming every पाठ value is ASCII-safe without an explicit narrowing
#     check.

fn narrow(string<8> raw) → ascii<4> {
    return raw ↦ ascii<4>
}

Expected: compilation rejects this example.

# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Bounded पाठ capacities are not interchangeable through a direct
#     resize बदलें.
#   • The unsupported route fails closed with `SEM016:unsupported_conversio`.
#
# Common mistakes:

fn resize(string<8> raw) → string<4> {
    return raw ↦ string<4>
}
